description.value: The study investigated whether individual Food Craving Questionnaire-Trait scores and subscale scores correlate with differential brain activation to high- versus low-caloric food cues in healthy male participants.

spans.text: The present study set out to validate the German versions of the Food Craving Questionnaire-Trait and -State at the neurobiological level using functional imaging in healthy human males.
